baseline_searches.query: China Datang "DSSP Power" Sumsel Kendari Indonesia power plant loans
baseline_searches.conducted: 2026-10-30, web-search tool available to the agent; one query, not a controlled or exhaustive search
references_retrieved: https://www.businesstimes.com.sg (China Datang $394M majority stake in DSS thermal plants, Dec 2020)
https://www.datang-dsspower.co.id (PT Datang DSSP Power Indonesia corporate site)
baseline_searches.found: Publicly reported 2020 acquisition of a majority stake in Dian Swastatika Sentosa thermal plants by China Datang (~$394M).
baseline_searches.not_surfaced: Per-plant loan records (AidData: CDB for Sumsel-5, 2012; CDB for Kendari-3, 2015) and the explicit two-plants-one-name-group structure were not surfaced by this query.
baseline_searches.verdict: PARTIAL OVERLAP ONLY. The acquisition is public knowledge; that specific prior loan records tie CDB to two plants now under one parent group was not surfaced here. This is limited evidence from one search, not proof of novelty. TEMPORAL CAVEAT: the 2020 acquisition postdates both loan commitments; the sponsor relationship at commitment time (2012, 2015) is NOT established by any source consulted.

baseline_searches.not_surfaced: The GEM unit-level mapping (Units 09-10 = 2x1000MW consistent with the announced 2GW) and AidData record 92603 (Bank of China participation in the $2.6B syndicate to PT Indo Raya Tenaga).
baseline_searches.verdict: PARTIAL OVERLAP ONLY; limited evidence from one search, not proof of novelty. OWNERSHIP CAVEAT: GEM's plant-level owner (PT Indonesia Power Suralaya 100%) reflects the multi-decade site; unit-level ownership of Units 09-10 was not resolved here and is NOT asserted.

baseline_limitations: Searches were run by the agent with a web-search tool on 2026-10-30 (one query each). They establish what one ordinary search surfaces for these specific phrasings on that date; they do not bound what a persistent human investigator, a different engine, or Indonesian-language queries would find. 'Not surfaced' is not 'does not exist', and partial overlap is not a novelty proof.
